Python API Reference¶

The API reference below is generated from Python docstrings in the project source. Update the docstring when behavior changes, then rebuild the HTML docs.

Booking expiry service¶

accounts.services.expire_pending_booking_requests(now=None)[source]¶

Expire overdue pending bookings and notify each affected traveler once.

The service rechecks every candidate under a database lock so a request that was answered concurrently is not overwritten. Email delivery happens after the database transactions complete.

Parameters:

now – Optional timezone-aware timestamp to use as the current time. The current Django time is used when this value is omitted.

Returns:

The number of booking requests changed to the expired state.

Guide search¶

accounts.views.guide_search_context(request)[source]¶

Build the verified-guide queryset and search-form template context.

Filters include destination, trip date, language, specialty, daily-price range, and minimum rating. Results are limited to the first 24 guides.

Returns:

A dictionary containing guides, search_form, has_search, and the selected trip_date value.

Registration and verification¶

accounts.views.register(request)[source]¶

Create a traveler account and send its email-verification link.

A valid POST creates an unverified account. Invalid input redisplays the registration form with field-level errors.

accounts.views.verify_email(request, uidb64, token)[source]¶

Validate a signed verification link and activate the user’s email.

Parameters:

  • uidb64 – URL-safe encoded primary key of the account to verify.

  • token – Time-sensitive token generated for that account.

Returns:

A redirect to login on success, or an invalid-link page with HTTP 400.

Guide application¶

accounts.views.apply_as_guide(request)[source]¶

Submit a guide application for administrator review.

The form validates the profile and uploaded documents. A successful submission creates a pending application and updates the user’s profile name and role where appropriate.

accounts.views.guide_application_review(request, application_id)[source]¶

Approve or reject a pending guide application as an administrator.

Rejections require a reason. Each completed decision is recorded in the guide decision audit log and is communicated to the applicant by email.

Booking workflows¶

accounts.views.book_guide(request, guide_id)[source]¶

Create a booking request with a verified guide.

The traveler must have a verified email. The view checks guide status, group size, date availability, and overlapping requests before it creates a pending booking and notifies the guide.

accounts.views.respond_to_booking_request(request, booking_id)[source]¶

Accept or decline a pending request owned by the current guide.

This is a POST-only action. Accepting rechecks date availability inside a transaction, reserves the dates, updates the booking, and notifies the traveler.

accounts.views.complete_booking(request, booking_id)[source]¶

Mark an ended, confirmed tour as complete for its assigned guide.

Completion increments the guide’s completed-tour count and enables the traveler to submit a review.

Reviews¶

accounts.views.submit_guide_review(request, booking_id)[source]¶

Publish one review for the authenticated traveler’s completed booking.

A transaction prevents duplicate reviews and recalculates the guide’s average rating and review count after a successful submission.
